# Keva

> Keva is a local-first AI agent for Android. It runs complete Claude Code and
> OpenAI Codex runtimes on a phone, without requiring root, a PC, or a cloud
> desktop. It can work with files, run code and tools, search the web, and
> manage Git repositories. The first public Android release is coming soon.

## Canonical links

- Website: https://keva.chat/
- Android download status: https://keva.chat/download/
- Public GitHub hub: https://github.com/SimonLeen22/keva-app
- English README: https://github.com/SimonLeen22/keva-app/blob/main/README.md
- Chinese README: https://github.com/SimonLeen22/keva-app/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md
- FAQ: https://github.com/SimonLeen22/keva-app/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md

## Product facts

- Category: on-device AI agent for Android; local-first; bring-your-own-provider.
- Runtimes: Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.
- Codex access: ChatGPT subscription sign-in or OpenAI API key.
- Other supported providers: DeepSeek, GLM, MiniMax, Kimi, and Qwen.
- Device: stock Android; no root and no separate computer required.
- Data: files, project data, and keys stay on the device; messages go to the model provider selected by the user.
- Source availability: Keva is closed source. This repository is for public documentation, product updates, feedback, and security disclosure; it does not host proprietary app source code.

## Demonstrated use cases

- Build a working Tetris game from scratch on an Android phone.
- Use Codex to research a week of AI developments and deliver an HTML industry report on the phone.
